actionable_steps.citation: Sathya and Dharma : bases of life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27 (1994), 1994-03-10
actionable_steps.step: Speak the truth always — it is easier than the cleverness needed to tell and sustain a lie; be true to your conscience.

actionable_steps.citation: Man, truth, love, and God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-04
actionable_steps.step: When you cannot utter the truth in a situation, desist from speaking and keep silent rather than utter a falsehood.

actionable_steps.citation: Be human — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1980-02-07
actionable_steps.step: Speak the truth pleasantly — never use truth to inflame passion, diminish enthusiasm or inflict injury.

actionable_steps.citation: The Glory of Bharat — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 23 (1990), 1990-05-20
actionable_steps.step: Hold on to Sathya and Dharma come what may — success follows Sathya and Dharma.

actionable_steps.citation: Man, truth, love, and God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-04
actionable_steps.step: Practise sathya and dharma daily, and you need not fear anything or anyone.

definition.citation: Truth Is Your Very Life Breath — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35 (2002), 2002-10-14
definition.quote: Truth is God. Where is truth? It is all-pervasive. It encompasses the entire creation. Trikalabadhyam sathyam (that which remains unchanged in the modes of perceived time - past, present, and future - is Truth).

discourses.citation: The Glory of Bharat — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 23 (1990), 1990-05-20
discourses.quote: To every man born on earth Truth is the visible manifestation of God. The entire cosmos composed of moving and immovable objects has emerged from Truth, is sustained by Truth and merges in Truth.

discourses.citation: Sathya and Dharma : bases of life — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27 (1994), 1994-03-10
discourses.quote: "Sathyam Vadha, Dharmam Chara." It is an injunction to man to speak the Truth and practise right conduct. This will help him to be true to his conscience. … In fact it is easier to speak the truth while it needs a lot of cleverness to tell an untruth and sustain it.

discourses.citation: Man, truth, love, and God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-04
discourses.quote: Why should you fear to speak the truth? You have to fear only when you commit mistakes. … When you aren't able to utter the truth, you may desist from speaking and keep silent.

discourses.citation: Be human — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1980-02-07
discourses.quote: "Sathyam brooyath, priyam brooyath" (Speak the truth, speak pleasantly). "Na brooyath sathyam apriyam" (If unpleasant, do not speak the Truth). "Priyam cha na anritham brooyath" (though it may be pleasant, do not speak falsehood).

make_it_real: Truth is God — so every truthful word you speak today is a small act of worship.
title: Truth (Sathya)

vahinis.quote: It will not incline toward the false; it will be on the alert to speak the truth. It will remain unruffled by lust, greed, anger, and conceit; it will be free from delusion.
